title: Shashi Tharoor Praises Gautam Gambhir As "Hardest Job In India After PM" Ahead Of India-NZ T20
text: Shashi Tharoor Praises Gautam Gambhir As “Hardest Job In India After PM” Ahead Of India-NZ T20Congress MP Shashi Tharoor has praised former BJP MP and cricket coach Gautam Gambhir, calling his role “the hardest job in India after the Prime Minister’s.” Tharoor, speaking ahead of the India-New Zealand T20 in Nagpur, described Gambhir as calm, determined, and undaunted despite daily scrutiny.
